title.ja: その恋は, 少女漫画化されてゆく.
title.en: This Love... Is Being Turned Into a Shojo Manga.
title.de: Diese Liebe wird zu einem Shojo-Manga
title.x-jat: Sono Koi wa, Shoujo Manga Kasarete Yuku.

1.overview: Chiyo Sakura, age 16, tells her crush Umetaro Nozaki that she is his fan, but he responds by giving her his autograph. She then says she wants to be with him always, so Nozaki invites her home and gives her some "beta work", which after several hours, she realizes she is doing inking for him. She realizes he is a shojo manga artist who is published in a magazine she has bought. Later, they think of romance ideas such as making a guy a delinquent but should obey the laws, and taking a girl home with a bicycle. Nozaki invites Sakura home but he has a tandem bicycle, so they see if any of the situations are conducive to romance. After seeing him interact with some cats, Sakura tries to confess her love again, but gets another autograph. Nozaki introduces Sakura to his friend.
1.summary:
Sakura Chiyo, age 16, falls in love with a boorish classmate named Nozaki Umetaro. One day, she gathers her courage and confesses her feelings to him... but somehow there is a misunderstanding, and he gives her his autograph. Upon further misunderstanding, Nozaki invites Chiyo to his house, where she suddenly becomes a manga artist`s assistant.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 新[ニュー]ヒロインをよろしくね♪
title.en: Say Hello to the New Heroine

2.overview: Nozaki introduces Sakura to his friend Mikoto Mikoshiba, a popular and flirtatious guy who Sakura soon learns is actually painfully shy and is often ashamed of his own words. He spends a session at Nozaki's place eagerly waiting for Sakura to ask him for help although he is too shy to prompt her. Sakura learns that Mikoshiba's artistic specialty is adding background decorations such as flowers, and she discovers that Mikoshiba is Nozaki's model for the heroine of his manga. Nozaki later asks Sakura if she has any friends who might fit in a shojo manga. Sakura introduces them to Yuzuki Seo, a girl who the guys discover has a habit of being insensitive and oblivious (not reading the atmosphere). However, she has an angelic singing voice, of which she is nicknamed the Glee Club's Lorelei.
2.summary:
Chiyo is introduced to Nozaki`s other assistant, who he calls Mikorin, Mikoshiba Mikoto. Chiyo was expecting someone who was the healing type, but instead finds out that he is the exact opposite. Mikorin tries to act tough as Chiyo`s senpai assistant, but he ends up having a rather surprising side to him...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: バイオレンスVSプリンス

3.overview: Mikoshiba introduces to Sakura and Nozaki his best friend, Yū Kashima, who is known as the school prince, but is actually a girl. She is a member of the acting club and is really popular among the girls. However, she is a bit dense and acts idiotic sometimes that her senior at acting club Masayuki Hori will scold and even physically beat her. After helping Hori paint some sets, Sakura discovers that he is the one who does backgrounds for Nozaki's manga. When Mashima sees Hori with Nozaki, she gets a bit jealous. Nozaki later has Hori and Sakura role-play some parts, during which Mikoshiba also gets involved.
3.summary:
Chiyo introduces Nozaki to her friend Seo Yuzuki since he wanted a model for a new character in "Let`s Fall in Love." She also asks Mikoshiba if he happens to know anyone that would be a good fit. Mikoshiba then introduces Chiyo to the Prince of the School.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 男には, 戦わねばならない, 時がある.
title.en: There Are Times When Men Must Fight.
title.de: Es gibt Zeiten, in denen ein Mann kämpfen muss
title.x-jat: Otoko ni wa, Tatakawanebanaranai, Toki ga Aru.

4.overview: Mikoshiba asks Nozaki if he can stay over in order to seek his advice regarding girls, however the "girls" turn out to be heroines of a dating simulation game. As they try out the game, they realize that the protagonist's best friend, Tomoda, has been caring for him throughout his adventures, which prompts Nozaki to make a story about their friendship, which appears to Sakura to be a Boy's Love-genre story. Later, Mikoshiba is invited to attend a mixer but is too shy to know what to do there, so Nozaki and Sakura practice with him.
4.summary:
Nozaki, Chiyo, and Mikorin are all at Nozaki`s house working on manga, as usual. They finish a day`s worth of work, and Mikorin says he`s going to stay the night at Nozaki`s. Chiyo can`t help but be a bit jealous of Mikorin, and asks them what they usually do when they have sleepovers. Mikorin says that he asks Nozaki for advice about girls, but that ends up being...
Source: crunchyroll

title.de: Der Mann, der sich die Liebe vorstellt und zeichnet

5.overview: Nozaki frantically cleans his apartment for his editor, Ken Miyamae, who appears and leaves so quickly that Sakura thinks he does not like Nozaki. However, Nozaki praises him in comparison to his previous editor Maeno, with whom he had bad experiences. Sakura meets Nozaki's neighbor, Yukari Miyako, who also draws manga in the same magazine, and later meets Maeno himself. When Ken tells Nozaki that the heroine of the manga should express more feelings, Nozaki pretends to act like the heroine for the day by giving lunches to his friends and carting Kashima away from a mob of livid girls. He concludes that Mamiko needs to study more and draws that into his storyboards.
5.summary:
One day, Chiyo drops in on Nozaki`s house and finds it cleaner than usual. Chiyo gets delusional and thinks that he cleaned up for her, but apparently that wasn`t the case. Nozaki then gets a phone call and starts panicking and tries to clean up even more. Apparently, the person on the phone is his editor, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔法をかけて, あ・げ・る♥
title.en: I`ll Cast a Spell on You

6.overview: Nozaki sees Hirotaka Wakamatsu, his junior from middle school when they were on the basketball club. Wakamatsu tells Nozaki about being stressed out and unable to sleep because of Seo's antics, however, when he hears a recording of Lorelei's singing, he immediately falls asleep and feels refreshed. Using Nozaki's shōjo manga as a basis, he confronts Seo, but she interprets his actions as gestures of friendship. Later on, Nozaki gets a fever and sends the text message "SOS" to Hori, Sakura, and Wakamatsu. The three team up to help Nozaki with his manga, but are challenged with the task of applying screentones.
6.summary:
Nozaki passes by the gymnasium to find his underclassman, Wakamatsu, being pummeled by Yuzuki. As the basketball team`s helper, Yuzuki seemed rather overzealous about going after just Wakamatsu, which causes him a lot of stress, which had turned into insomnia.
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: When Nozaki agrees to go with Sakura on his day off, Sakura thinks of it is a date situation, but Nozaki uses the time to get more manga ideas. They go to the mall and encounter Mikoshiba at a doll store. Later on, Mikoshiba volunteers to model for the art club.
7.summary:
Nozaki finishes up a deadline early for once, and then realizes that he has absolutely no hobbies. Chiyo sees this, and tries to invite him to do something that people would do on their day off. After he agrees, Chiyo realizes that this seems like they`re on a date, which excites her. However, they go to the mall to go shopping and...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 学園の王子様(女子)の悩み
title.en: The Prince (Girl) of the School`s Problems

8.overview: Kashima has been driving Hori crazy with her antics, but she gets confused when she discovers that Hori and the guys have been reading Yumeno’s shojo manga and taking it rather seriously. Hori challenges Nozaki to do some backgrounds, but Nozaki frustrates him when he does not get the perspective right, placing boxes under his characters to compensate. Thinking Hori aspires to be a princess, Kashima replaces his clothes with something more feminine. When Hori collapses during a rehearsal, Kashima carries him to the nurse’s office while wearing a bull mask.
8.summary:
Kashima feels that Hori is being cold to her recently, and Mikoshiba tells her that it`s because she lacks appeal. Mikoshiba tells Kashima to push and push hard, so she does, and one day, she finds a copy of "Let`s Fall in Love" in Hori`s bag. Of course, she doesn`t know that he has it in his bag because he`s helping out with the manga, so her imagination starts to run wild on why he has it...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ドキドキ, たりてる?

9.overview: When Sakura and Nozaki both forget to bring umbrellas for a rainy day, Nozaki takes the opportunity to gather romance ideas about umbrella sharing for his manga. After Seo gives them her umbrella, Chiyo cherishes the walk from school. Later, the two observe how Miyako deals with editor Maeno’s crazy recommendations, and tell her to stand up to him.
9.summary:
One rainy day after school, both Nozaki and Chiyo forget their umbrellas and decide to try out a solution used in shojo manga... and using a jacket as cover... but they quickly realize that doesn`t work, and rush back. Despite being drenched, Nozaki still tries to think of other solutions to this problem that he can think of from shojo mangas and...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 強まるのは, 絆と手綱.
title.en: What`s Strengthened Is Our Bond and Our Reins
title.de: Was stärker geworden ist, sind unsere Verbindung und unsere Zügel
title.x-jat: Tsuyomaru no wa, Kizuna to Tazuna.

10.overview: Hoping for some ideas for his side characters, Nozaki has Wakamatsu accept a movie date with Seo. When Hori suggests doing a musical production, Kashima scrambles for help as she is tone-deaf and cannot sing. During rehearsals, Hori duels Kashima, but when Mikoshiba is volunteered to do a part, Hori realizes he resembles Mamiko.
10.summary:
Ken-san asks about doing a story with the sub characters that are based on Yuzuki and Wakamatsu. Wakamatsu then visits Nozaki, telling him that Yuzuki gave him movie tickets and he doesn`t know what to do. Nozaki then tells Wakamatsu that he should totally go with Yuzuki, despite his obvious reservations, and so Wakamatsu ends up on a date with Yuzuki.
Source: crunchyroll

11.overview: Nozaki wants to create some excitement within the manga's story, and for reference, he tries a variety of strategies to surprise Sakura. Later, Mikoshiba, Hori, and Wakamatsu get caught in the rain, and all sleep over at Nozaki's apartment for shelter. Nozaki begins to use the others as a reference point for another chapter of the manga.
11.summary:
Fearing that the love story between Suzuki and Mamiko is lacking something exciting, Nozaki asks Chiyo for some ideas when she visits. Chiyo suggests doing something that`ll surprise or shock, so Nozaki tells her that he`ll try that out on her and that he wants her honest opinion. He then starts doing things that are meant to shock and surprise her at school, but...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: この気持ちが恋じゃないなら, きっと世界に恋はない.
title.en: If This Feeling Isn`t Love, Then There Is No Love in the World.
title.de: Wenn das Gefühl nicht Liebe ist, dann gibt es keine Liebe in der Welt
title.x-jat: Kono Kimochi ga Koi ja Nai nara, Kitto Sekai ni Koi wa Nai.

12.overview: Chiyo tries to advance her relationship with Nozaki when she finds that she still has not given him the chocolates she had for Valentine’s Day. Chiyo, Nozaki and their friends attend a summer festival where Chiyo is reminded of the time when she and Nozaki first met.
12.summary:
Chiyo finds the Valentine`s chocolates she meant to give to Nozaki, but failed to, in the back of her fridge. Despite Valentine`s being long over, she knows that her feelings of love are still left in the chocolates... She realizes how her life has changed for the better since she became his assistant, and she decides to give it one more try...
Source: crunchyroll
